summary: Ask Rime no longer stops with an error on a right answer: your name, a reminder it just set, a fact in your own words, a time or number written your way, a course named by its code, or a plain "nothing came back" from your school. When an answer breaks one of Ask Rime's rules, Rime gets one more try with the reason instead of an error. Ask Rime's study help answers greetings and questions about you, and takes a question as asked instead of refusing it as the wrong kind.
